t: Funds appropriated by section 101 of this division for International Space Station Cargo Crew Services/International Partner Purchases within the National Aeronautics and Space Administration may be obligated in the account and budget structure set forth in the pertinent Acts specified in section 101(a)(9).

fable.w: This is an appropriations provision that only says NASA funds may be obligated within a specified account and budget structure. The tempting reading is that "International Partner" signals coordination with outside entities, but the phrase is just the name of a budget line item. No outside party is consulted, heard, or given a right to challenge any federal decision.
fable.s: International Space Station Cargo Crew Services/International Partner Purchases

qwen_block.w: This section is a purely administrative provision regarding the obligation of appropriated funds within the National Aeronautics and Space Administration. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or decision-making process with entities outside the federal government. The mention of 'International Partner Purchases' refers to the purpose of the funds, not a participatory process with those partners in the context of this specific statutory text.
qwen_block.s: Funds appropriated by section 101 of this division for International Space Station Cargo Crew Services/International Partner Purchases within the National Aeronautics and Space Administration may be obligated in the account and budget structure set forth in the pertinent Acts specified in section 101(a)(9).

opus.w: This section only lets NASA spend certain appropriated funds under an existing account and budget structure; it sets up no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body or right to sue. The phrase "International Partner Purchases" names a budget line and does not create any process for outside parties to take part in a federal decision.

opus.b:
I'm labelling this **No**. It is a funding provision: it only says which budget account NASA may use for certain appropriated money.

The tempting reading is that "International Partner Purchases" or "Cargo Crew Services" brings outside parties into a federal decision. That fails because these words are just the name of a budget line. Nothing in the section has states, partners, companies or the public consult on, comment on, advise on or challenge a federal decision.
